description_en: Queries the details of a specified data destination
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定数据目的详细信息
name: GetDestination

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data destination ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433025.html operation to query the list of data destinations and obtain the DestinationId
parameters.help_zh: 数据目的ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433025.html，查询数据目的列表，获取**DestinationId**
parameters.name: destination_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Configuration.description_en: The configuration information of the data destination
Configuration.description_zh: 数据目的对应的配置信息

IsFailover.description_en:
Indicates whether the data destination is configured to forward error data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services after retries.

true: The data destination forwards error data.
false: The data destination performs normal forwarding operations.

Default value: false
IsFailover.description_zh:
该数据目的配置是否为转发错误操作数据，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

true：是转发错误操作数据。
false：不是转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作。

默认值为false

Name.description_en: The name of the data destination

Status.description_en:
The status of the data destination. Valid values:

INIT: being initialized.
NORMAL: running as expected.
INVALID: abnormal configuration. The data destination is unavailable.
SHORTCUT: an exception occurred in the data forwarding service, which triggered circuit breaking
Status.description_zh:
数据目的对应的状态。返回值：

INIT：初始配置中。
NORMAL：配置完成，正常可用。
INVALID：配置存在异常，不可用。
SHORTCUT：云产品流转服务发生异常，导致流转熔断

Type.description_en:
The operation type of the data destination.

REPUBLISH: forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to another communication topic on IoT Platform.
AMQP: forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to an AMQP consumer group via data forwarding.
DATAHUB: forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.
ONS: forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for MSMQ distribution.
MNS: sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
FC: sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
OTS: sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage
Type.description_zh:
数据目的的操作类型。

REPUBLISH：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至物联网平台的另一个通信Topic。
AMQP：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据流转到AMQP消费组。
DATAHUB：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。
ONS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。
MNS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
FC：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
OTS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储

UtcCreated.description_en: The time when the data destination was created in UTC. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` format
UtcCreated.description_zh: 创建数据目的对应的UTC时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'`

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
